channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: 🔒 Millis private school constructing 18K-sq.-ft. building for high school expansion
item.description: The new building is expected to open for the 2026-27 school year.

item.title: Former Westborough cinema to become Hindu worship site, following $5.1M sale
item.description: The site was purchased by a Hindu denomination headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, which has more than 5,000 centers of worship across the globe.

item.title: 🔒 Berkshire Bank rebrands as Beacon Bank following merger
item.description: The banks integrated their systems over the weekend, with temporary Beacon signs appearing at the bank’s Downtown Worcester location on Tuesday.

item.title: 🔒 Lifeward misses deadline, granted temporary extension to avoid Nasdaq delisting
item.description: Lifeward received its deficiency letter on Aug. 5.

item.title: 🔒 Waters finalizes $19B bioscience division acquisition
item.description: The closure comes seven months after Waters announced its acquisition plans in July.

item.title: Tensions flare at cannabis agency meeting over fine payments
item.description: The tension between O'Brien and some on the CCC staff was apparent, particularly during a portion of the meeting when General Counsel Kajal Chattopadhyay repeatedly sought, but was denied, an opportunity to speak.

item.title: Board of Higher Education approves pilot pathway for three-year bachelor’s degrees
item.description: The Board of Higher Education has opened the door for colleges and universities across Massachusetts to offer three-year bachelor’s degrees, a move aimed at boosting access to higher degrees while some have raised concerns it could diminish education quality.

item.title: Labor organizers seeking first app-based rideshare driver union
item.description: The state determined in December that an aspiring union group met the threshold to be recognized as the bargaining representative of at least 5% of rideshare drivers.

item.title: 🔒 Spencer developer looking to build 48 apartments on Worcester’s Plantation Street
item.description: The 2.7-acre parcel is a grassy vacant lot on a hill overlooking Shrewsbury Street and the CSX Worcester Rail Yard.

item.title: Milford biopharma selects incoming COO following executive shakeup
item.description: Veit Bergendahl previously led commissioning of his former firm’s R&D site and managed its single-use clinical manufacturing facility, featuring two 2,000-liter bioreactors.
